item.text: The ResStock team recommends **at least 1,000 samples** when no analysis-specific guidance is available. This is a conservative reference intended to keep sampling discrepancy at **15% or less for many common quantities of interest**. [ResStock FAQ](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/FAQ.html)
